picks.title: Joint Investigation Report: China is Trying to Get U.S. Companies Addicted to Chinese AI Models
picks.source: House Select Committee on the CCP
picks.rationale: Geopolitics axis, primary document: the chairs of the House China Select Committee (Moolenaar) and Homeland Security Committee (Garbarino) released a joint investigation report on US firms building on Chinese open-weight models. It names the provenance, training-data and distillation questions every team shipping on those models now faces. Claims are attributed to the committees.
picks.excerpt: Chairs Moolenaar (China Select Committee) and Garbarino (Homeland Security) released a joint investigation report on US companies integrating Chinese open-weight AI models (origin, training data, possible unauthorized distillation) and on whether the US open-weight AI strategy leaves firms a real alternative. Investigation began April 2026 with letters to Anysphere (Cursor) and Airbnb.

picks.title: Effort to regulate 'killer robots' delayed to 2028
picks.rationale: Geopolitics and policy axis, new decision: the CCW Seventh Review Conference closed with 128 states adopting a two-year mandate to draft an international instrument on lethal autonomous weapons, reporting in 2028. This is the adopted outcome, not the pre-conference positioning covered on 11-09.
picks.excerpt: The CCW Seventh Review Conference closed with 128 states agreeing to launch 'the elaboration of an international instrument on lethal autonomous weapons systems' over two years, reporting to a 2028 meeting; Russia blocked a firmer mandate and binding status was left open.

picks.title: 2026 Elections: Man indicted over fake video of Puma Shen
picks.rationale: Elections axis, new filing: Taoyuan prosecutors indicted a man and are seeking a one-year sentence under the election and recall law for posting a deepfake voice video of a Taipei mayoral candidate ahead of the Nov. 28 vote. It is a criminal indictment, a separate event from the 11-21 card on accounts flagged to Meta.
picks.excerpt: Taoyuan prosecutors indicted a 49-year-old man and are seeking a one-year sentence under the Civil Servants Election and Recall Act for posting a deepfake voice video of DPP Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen on Threads ahead of the 11-28 local elections.

picks.title: 靑, '시험공정성회복TF' 구성…'AI부정행위 근절' 근본대책 마련
picks.rationale: Policy axis, new official action: the presidential office expanded its emergency suneung AI-cheating TF into a standing 'Exam Fairness Recovery TF' led by the chief of staff and ordered a central tip-off center under the Prime Minister's office. The president also ordered a full overhaul of national exams. These steps go beyond the 11-18 announcement of post-exam probes with big tech.
picks.excerpt: 청와대가 수능 직전 꾸린 'AI 악용 부정행위 비상 대응 TF'를 '시험 공정성 회복 TF'(단장 비서실장)로 확대하고, 총리실 주관 중앙제보센터 가동을 지시했다. 같은 날 이 대통령은 국가시험 제도 전면 개편을 주문.

picks.title: Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' for moving AI data centers outside the US
picks.rationale: Geopolitics axis: President Trump said he could impose a 'tremendous tax' on, or ban, US companies that build AI data centers abroad. It is a stated intent from the president, not a written policy, and he said he had not yet run the idea by staff. The card must present it that way. This is the single pick from the BBC/Verge cluster, chosen because The Verge is on the politics whitelist.
picks.excerpt: Trump floated a 'tremendous tax' on US companies that build AI data centers overseas, saying he had not run the idea by staff.

https://www.politico.eu/article/effort-r.new_action: CCW Seventh Review Conference adopted its outcome: 128 states agreed a two-year mandate to elaborate an international instrument on lethal autonomous weapons, reporting in 2028. The 11-09 card covered only the pre-conference push by Russia and the US to block binding rules.
